summary: Tested the referral map's switch from Google Maps to Leaflet + OSM, plus the small activity/pending fixes. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed. Two TEST_ referral partners (Joondalup WA 6027, Fremantle WA 6160) were geocoded in the background on add, each correctly placed. /api/referral-map returns Leaflet + OSM tiles, X-Map-Pins>=2 and no Google script. postcode=6000 gives a 'Participant area 6000' centre. Missing or bogus token returns 401. An entry with no address shows 'Showing N of M partners'. Pending entries are excluded, a <script> name is escaped, editing an address re-geocodes, and the summary endpoint works. Locking an activity poll changes the description to 'The team voted for X.'. Frontend (390x844): employee Drive > Therapist > Referral Partners > Map loads OSM tiles with 2 markers in the iframe. Tapping a marker opens a popup with name/services/address/phone. Postcode 6000 adds the blue dot with a 'Participant area 6000' tooltip. Changing the postcode while on the map updates the iframe src. As admin, the pending Activity card has no 'Make it a team event' or Share button. The Reject sheet title is 'Reject TEST_Pending Activity?'. The event page shows 'The team voted for TEST_UIAct 0.' after Lock in. All TEST_ data was cleaned up (geocache kept). Live geocoder calls: about 3.

minor.issue: Nominatim fallback runs only when Photon returns non-200. If Photon times out or throws, there is no fallback (the except path skips it). If Photon returns 200 with no AU feature, a failure is cached permanently without trying Nominatim.

Every map load starts a geocode_later task for each entry still needing geo (beyond the first 8), with no de-dup. Repeated loads queue duplicate tasks behind the lock. The asyncio.create_task results are not kept, so tasks may be garbage-collected.
The first load with many ungeocoded entries blocks for up to ~9s (8 lookups x 1.1s). Acceptable, but the UI has no loading indicator over the iframe.

ui_bugs.issue: With postcode 6000 + Nearby (±10) giving no matches, the empty state says 'No trusted referral partner organisations yet / Tap Suggest…'. It should say 'No matches nearby'. Only `search` is checked for this message, not postcode (directory.tsx:252).
The title says 'Reject X?' but the confirm button still says 'Remove' (directory.tsx:415). Consider 'Reject' when the entry is pending.

issues: The map ignores the radius chips (Same/Nearby/Wider): all partners are always pinned. This may be intended but could confuse users, since the chips stay visible in Map view.

action_items: Optional: in geocode(), fall back to Nominatim when Photon throws or returns no AU result before caching a failure
Optional: de-dup background geocode tasks (in-flight set) and keep task references
Optional: empty-state message for postcode-filtered referral list; 'Reject' confirm label for pending entries
Update stale comments: referral-map.tsx:7 still says 'Google Map'; referral_map.py docstring mentions only Nominatim
critical_code_review_comments: The session token is passed in the iframe/WebView URL query (?token=). It may leak to access logs, history and the Referer header sent to unpkg/OSM tile servers. Consider a short-lived map-specific token.
XSS handling is good: json.dumps with '</' escaped and textContent for popup content; links are restricted to http(s).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ referral partners, pending activity and activity vote events; all removed via seed_iter33_ui.py clean. Geocache now holds 4 real-address entries (left in place).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest -n 0. Geocache already has joondalup wa 6027, fremantle wa 6160 and 6000, so reruns don't hit Photon.
